item_reviews.comment: Counts check: GPT-4 2/4, GPT-3.5 3/4 non-medical significant, no medical significant; non-medical means higher (≈0.255 vs 0.223; 0.278 vs 0.193).
Pooled means ≈0.240 vs 0.241; GPT-2, Gemma, Mistral have significant medical cells; many non-medical cells non-significant.
Under alternative embeddings all cells significant and omegas change sharply, e.g. robot 0.26→0.04, child 0.33→0.48.
T2 note says generating LLM unnamed; Ada column matches GPT-3.5 in T1. Limitation is supported.
T1 note says no multiple-comparison correction indicated; only star thresholds are given, with many separate tests.
Directly supported by P1 on interpreting non-rejection; useful interpretive caveat.

missing_core_findings.description: Under Jasper, Stella and Kalm, every persona cell is significant, including medical roles, though medical omegas are small (0.02–0.09) and mostly below non-medical ones except the robot. Significance alone therefore does not separate medical from non-medical roles. Effect size does, apart from the robot persona.
